types.name: data
types.description: The data of the workflow execution.

children.name: invoke
children.description:
The details of the invocation of the workflow execution's steps.
The key is the step's ID, and the value is the step's details.

These details are only included for steps that have their `saveResponse` property set to `true`.

children.name: output
children.description: The output details of the step.

children.name: payload
children.description: The payload or input of the workflow execution.

types.name: compensate
types.description:
The output of the compensation function of the workflow execution.
The key is the step's ID, and the value is the compensation function's output.

These details are only included for steps that have their `saveResponse` property set to `true`.

types.name: errors
types.description: The errors of the workflow execution.

children.name: action
children.description: The ID of the action that failed.

children.name: handlerType
children.description: The type of the handler that failed. It can be `invoke` or `compensate`.
